title: situation.tennessee_forces_state_order.title

gate.none: Administrative entry of state military forces only; no motive or secession-cause claim, slavery policy, security order, civilian conduct or protected-population effect.

citations.at: I-IV pp.431,436. Retrospective: Harris to Benjamin, 28 September, describing the July 31 general order, and Benjamin to Harris, 4 October, on pay. Original order and individual verified receipts unread.

namedOnly: The state institution’s act is reported; no individual’s speech or discretionary decision is asserted.
